description: This PHP source file defines the class `Std` within the `FastRoute\RouteParser` namespace, which is responsible for parsing route strings that may contain optional segments and placeholders, used in routing within web frameworks. It implements the `RouteParser` interface and provides logic to parse route patterns like `/user/{name}[/{id:[0-9]+}]` into structured data.

classes.name: Std
classes.description: A class that parses route strings with optional segments and placeholders into structured route data, handling nested patterns and validation.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a route string with optional segments into an array of route data, splitting segments based on optional brackets and handling placeholders.

methods.name: parsePlaceholders
methods.description: Parses route strings without optional segments to identify placeholders and their patterns, returning structured data for route matching.
